$comment: SHARED CONTRACT FIXTURE - keep byte-identical in hots and hots-connector. Direction: hots-connector -> HOTS, on the topic named by connector.parameters.topic_data. Each Kafka message is one object from `messages` below.
notes: Field names are configurable via the top-level `data` config section; the payload keys themselves (timestamp/container_id/machine_id) are fixed by this contract.
The metric key ('cpu' here) must match the single entry of data.metrics.
A container whose metric key is absent or null is skipped, not defaulted to zero.
`v` is the message schema version (currently 1). Consumers must tolerate it being absent (a pre-versioning sender) but should warn on an unrecognized value rather than fail outright.
